# mdspace

Multidimensional scaling (MDS) in R, with a focus on visualizing
asymmetric proximities. The package is under development.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("kosugitti/mdspace")
```

## Models

| Function | Model | Reference |
|----|----|----|
| [`circle_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/circle_mds.md) | Circle model (radius-distance model); one-mode two-way and two-mode three-way | Okada & Imaizumi (1987, 1997) |
| [`ellipse_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/ellipse_mds.md) | Ellipse model | Okada (1990) |
| [`vonmises_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/vonmises_mds.md) | Von Mises model (AMISESCAL) | Shojima (2011, 2012) |
| [`hfm_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/hfm_mds.md) | Hermitian form model (HFM) | Chino & Shiraiwa (1993) |
| [`gstatis_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/gstatis_mds.md) | GSTATIS | Chino, Grorud & Yoshino (1996) |

Helpers:
[`as_proximity()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/as_proximity.md),
[`asym_decomp()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/asym_decomp.md),
[`missing_pattern()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/missing_pattern.md).

## Example

``` r

library(mdspace)

# x: a square matrix of asymmetric similarities
fit <- circle_mds(x, ndim = 2)
fit
plot(fit)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_proximity()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/as_proximity.md)
  : Coerce data to a square proximity matrix
- [`asym_decomp()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/asym_decomp.md)
  : Decompose a square matrix into symmetric and skew-symmetric parts
- [`circle_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/circle_mds.md)
  : Nonmetric asymmetric MDS by the radius-distance (circle) model
- [`ellipse_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/ellipse_mds.md)
  : Nonmetric asymmetric MDS by the ellipse-distance (Model II) and
  radius-distance (Model III) models
- [`gstatis_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/gstatis_mds.md)
  : GSTATIS: STATIS for a set of asymmetric matrices via Hermitian forms
- [`hfm_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/hfm_mds.md)
  : Hermitian form model for asymmetric proximities
- [`missing_pattern()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/missing_pattern.md)
  : Missing-value patterns of asymmetric proximity matrices
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace.md)
  : Plot the configuration of an mdspace object
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_asym>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_asym.md)
  : Plot the skew-symmetric part as a heat map
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_circle>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_circle.md)
  : Plot a radius-distance (circle) model solution
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_ellipse>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_ellipse.md)
  : Plot an ellipse-distance or radius-distance model solution
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_gstatis>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_gstatis.md)
  : Plot a GSTATIS solution
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_hfm>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_hfm.md)
  : Plot one complex plane of an HFM solution
- [`plot(`*`<mdspace_vonmises>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/plot.mdspace_vonmises.md)
  : Plot a von Mises model solution
- [`print(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/print.mdspace.md)
  : Print an mdspace object
- [`run_app()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/run_app.md)
  : mdspace Shiny アプリケーションを起動する
- [`summary(`*`<mdspace>`*`)`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/summary.mdspace.md)
  : Summarize an mdspace object
- [`vonmises_mds()`](https://kosugitti.github.io/mdspace/reference/vonmises_mds.md)
  : Asymmetric MDS by the von Mises model (AMISESCAL)
